name: Pet Boy
source:
After being kidnapped from his world and sold on a supernatural black market, our protagonist was purchased as a pet by a powerful and enigmatic sorcerer. Now, he works delivering potions to his charming clients.

[From [url=https://garula.itch.io/pet-boy]Itch.io[/url]]
